name: Frame Review (preview-grade visual QA)
purpose: Seeks a composition frame by frame in headless Chromium (Playwright), captures sample frames per format, and reports layout and craft findings before or without a HyperFrames render: clipped or overlapping text, text below the size floor, safe-area violations, estimated contrast, dead stretches, blank frames, unread lines and runtime errors. Writes contact sheets and a cross-format matrix.
capabilities: Per-format sampling of studio projects (index.<format>.html) and legacy single-format projects
Findings: text_clipped_by_frame, text_overlap, text_below_floor, outside_safe_area, low_contrast, dead_stretch, first_frame_empty, blank_frames, line_unread, timeline_past_end, page errors
Contact sheet per format plus contact-matrix.png for creative review
Optional --fonts google to approximate HyperFrames-bundled fonts on hosts without them

installation.instructions: pip install playwright pillow numpy; python -m playwright install chromium (development/QA hosts only).

compatibility.notes: Verified on Windows with Playwright 1.62 Chromium. Preview grade only: it does not replace hyperframes check/render; font rasterisation and timing can differ from HyperFrames' capture.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace tool. Playwright is Apache-2.0; Pillow is MIT-CMU; numpy is BSD-3-Clause.

security.notes: Serves the project's src/ directory on 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral port for the duration of the run. Network: the page loads GSAP from cdnjs and, with --fonts google, Google Fonts CSS. Writes only to projects/<slug>/qa/frame-review/ or --out.

approval_evidence: Run on projects/masala-chai-recipe (3 formats) and projects/benchmark-neural-network (legacy) on 2026-10-30; findings cross-checked by viewing contact sheets.
